How we make money

Listings are free and we never charge a business to be included or to change what we say about it.

  • Paid links. Some links to online services (for example freelancer marketplaces, courses or software) are affiliate links. If you buy, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. These are labelled "Paid link".
  • Referral fees. Some local providers pay us a referral fee if a business we introduce becomes their customer. Cards for those providers show "We may be paid".
  • Sponsors. In future, providers may pay for a clearly labelled "Sponsored" box. Sponsored boxes sit apart from the list and never change its order.
  • Our own service. Our founder also offers AI training in Western New York. It's shown in a separate "Our own service" box and is never ranked inside the independent list.

We don't accept payment to change our descriptions, and we don't publish ratings.
